name: Crescendo
tagline: Fully-managed AI-native customer service, replaces your entire CX stack with agents, QA and human-in-the-loop support, billed per resolution.
verdict: Crescendo’s pitch is speed and completeness: instead of stitching together a chat widget, a ticketing system and an outsourced BPO separately, it sells all of it — AI agents, QA, routing, knowledge management and human-in-the-loop staff — as one per-resolution-priced engagement. The backing is real: a $500M valuation and the PartnerHero acquisition gave it enterprise-scale delivery capacity within its first year, and its all-inclusive pricing plus Total Outcome Guarantee genuinely aligns cost with results. The tradeoffs are the ones you would expect from a fully managed service: no public API or self-serve trial, limited hands-on configuration control, and per-resolution billing that needs careful volume forecasting to avoid surge fees. Pick Crescendo if you want an outsourced, compliance-ready CX operation you do not have to build yourself; skip it if you want a self-serve, developer-controlled agent like Intercom Fin, or a software-only platform you configure in-house like Sierra.
